prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Busan — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Busan as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Busan with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: an all-night soup bar two centuries on — a curved counter of warm-lit smart glass, a great steel cauldron of milky bone broth behind it and a steaming bowl of soup with rice, chives and little dishes of salted shrimp and kimchi.
Around her, as her world makes them: a heavy heat-keeping bowl of steaming milky pork-bone soup with rice and chopped chives, a faint glowing rim; heat-sealed takeaway trays with glowing lids; a glass of glowing liquor on a lit base.
Season: early summer — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: evening turning to night — the scene lit by its own lamps and windows under a dark sky; lamps lit inside, the window dark with night.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a 1950s halter playsuit — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, terracotta, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with fine lace trim along the edges, a close, neatly tailored fit and a single strand of small pearls, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the left of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the left of the frame; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she brings a self-heating tumbler with a glowing band to her lips; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a small floating glass seed-globe with a tiny glowing sprout inside — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
